action_reads.note: Detach is visible as a widening gap at Pim's feet (f288-300); the hinge-up reads as the flat shape rising (f304-312); eyes pop f318, raspberry tongue f324-336, sprint loop behind Pim f348-370 and the taunt by the tree f372-394. Pim has no shadow from f300 on.

performance.note: Pim leans in squinting, then recoils hands-up with a tremble and hat spring (f310-345); the twin has anticipation before the sprint (f342-348) and leans into its run. Timing between samples not judged: frames only.

feasible_look.note: At 360x640 (phone-f00333) the dark twin, its white eyes and pink tongue, Pim's face and the cap all read; the flat shadow layer merges cleanly with the tree shade.

suggestions: f304-306: the mid-hinge sliver is a brief dark smear; acceptable at speed but watch it in playback.
f312-346: the standing twin overlaps the tree trunk; readable because of its eyes, but a cleaner separation would help.
